QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) forwards that empty vector. It also returns empty when `tokenizer_` is null.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns an empty vector for a failed tokenization (forwarded) and also returns empty when the tokenizer is not wired (`tokenizer_` null), so the two cases give the same value.
